cards.title: Remotes
cards.body: GitHub keeps a copy of your repository online. A remote is Git's name for that copy; the usual name is `origin`.
cards.code:
git init
git remote add origin https://github.com/you/demo.git
git remote -v

hi.title: Remotes
hi.body: GitHub aapki repository ki ek copy online rakhta hai. Remote us copy ke liye Git ka naam hai; aam taur par naam `origin` hota hai.

cards.title: Creating the GitHub side
cards.body: On github.com you create an empty repository and copy its URL. In these lessons, that repository already exists for you.

hi.title: GitHub wali side banana
hi.body: github.com par aap ek khaali repository banate ho aur uska URL copy karte ho. In lessons mein woh repository aapke liye pehle se bani hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The second command fails. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git init
git remote add https://github.com/you/notes.git
git remote -v

bug.fix: `git remote add` needs a name before the URL: `git remote add origin https://github.com/you/notes.git`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Doosri command fail hoti hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `git remote add` ko URL se pehle ek naam chahiye: `git remote add origin https://github.com/you/notes.git`.

check.question: What is `origin` in `git remote add origin <url>`?
options: A short name for the GitHub URL
check.explanation: After this, `origin` stands for the URL in every command.

hi.question: `git remote add origin <url>` mein `origin` kya hai?
hi.explanation: Iske baad har command mein `origin` us URL ki jagah kaam karta hai.

exercise.prompt: An empty repository is waiting at `https://github.com/you/site.git`. Add it as a remote called `origin`.
exercise.promptHi: `https://github.com/you/site.git` par ek khaali repository intezaar kar rahi hai. Use `origin` naam ke remote ki tarah jodo.
